desc:
An eBay ongoing management starter plan gives your account steady care: a review, a task list and the first round of work done. Ecom Swift LLC refreshes listings, checks orders and tracking, handles buyer messages and offers, and sends you a written summary.

## Why does an eBay account need regular care?

An eBay account is never finished. Listings go stale, stock changes, buyer messages arrive at all hours and offers expire if nobody answers them. Small jobs left for a few weeks pile up, and that is how a healthy account slowly turns into a source of defects and unanswered questions.

Regular care also protects the record that buyers and eBay see. Late shipments, slow replies and neglected cases all show up in seller performance. A steady routine keeps those numbers from slipping while you are busy with other work.

## How steady care affects results

Consistent attention improves the things within your control: how fresh your listings look, how fast buyers hear back and how reliably orders leave on time. Buyers notice a seller who answers quickly and ships when promised, and that feeds feedback and repeat purchases.

We cannot control demand, season or competition. We can make sure that when a buyer arrives, the listing is current, the message is answered and the parcel is tracked. That is the part of the process a seller can influence every week.

## What a good starter plan includes

- A review of your account health, policies and open items.
- A written task list with each job named and ordered by importance.
- Listing refreshes: updated titles, photos, prices or item specifics where they have drifted.
- Order and tracking checks, so nothing sits unshipped.
- Replies to buyer messages in your tone and within your rules.
- Handling of incoming offers according to limits you set.
- A weekly care checklist that you can keep using.
- A monthly calendar showing what happens and when.
- A short written summary of what was done and what was found.

## What we do

We begin with an account review and agree the task list with you. A routine task is a small, repeatable job, such as refreshing one listing, answering a batch of messages or checking a set of orders. Because the work is a fixed sprint, it is counted in tasks, so you know what is covered.

The Basic package sets the plan and completes the first tasks. The Standard package covers more tasks across a first month, with progress updates along the way. The Premium package adds weekly updates, more listings refreshed, a seller report and a three-month plan. If you want us to continue, a monthly plan is quoted separately, based on what your account really needed.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which actions need your approval first, such as price changes.
- Share your preferred tone for buyer replies.
- Flag any item you plan to stop selling.
- Read the weekly updates and answer questions quickly.
- Keep your own stock and cost records current.

**Avoid:**
- Handing over the account with no rules about prices or refunds.
- Expecting new products to be sourced as part of routine care.
- Making large changes yourself while we work on the same listings.
- Ignoring the summary, since it shows what needs a decision.
- Treating the starter plan as a promise of higher sales.

## Who this is for

This service suits a seller who has outgrown doing everything alone and wants to see how outside help would work. It suits a shop owner returning from a break with a backlog, and a business that wants a trial month of structured care before deciding on regular support.

## What we need from you

Tell us what your priorities are, what you want left alone and what needs your sign-off. Send any notes about your products, your tone with buyers and your usual shipping routine. We never ask for your password. Wherever eBay allows delegated access, you add us as a limited user, and you can see and remove that access yourself at any time.
